entries.title: Fixed Platform and Film Carriage Wrapper
entries.description: One newly authored complete static floor-platform stretch-wrapper appearance. A low circular platform and its support base are joined by a grounded bridge to a tall twin-guide mast. A fixed side carriage carries one opaque annular film-roll shape with central spindle, upper and lower retaining pads and two finite vertical guide rollers. A blank control box sits on the mast exterior. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one prop and zero scenes. No pallet, cargo, stretched sheet, true multilayer winding, motor, chain, powered lift, rotation, film tension, wrapping demonstration, throughput, operating instructions or safety claim. The opaque roll is one thick closed annular body rather than simulated transparent film layers. New complete geometry, not a pottery turntable or photo backdrop enlarged.

entries.title: Fixed Three Cup and Counter Anemometer
entries.description: One newly authored complete static cup-anemometer instrument appearance. Three separate thick hemispherical cups have genuine bowl interiors, open circular mouths and complete rim faces, facing tangentially around one horizontal rotor arrangement. Three entire thin spokes join their solid side walls to a low central hub on a slender vertical shaft. An independent chamfered counter-case exterior below the shaft has one blank circular inset face and fixed illustrative pointer. Three full splayed legs and finite individual feet support the whole instrument. Every whole shell, arm and case is new numerical geometry; no old wind rotor, bowl, tripod or gauge component is imported. This is not the old two tall semicylindrical cups between full upper/lower discs in a portal, nor narrow bowed full-height turbine blades changed in number. One prop and zero scenes. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Small fixed overlaps are static attachment appearances only. No rotating or swept-clearance mechanism, calibrated measurement, wind capture, wind-speed or direction reading, sensing, counter transmission, electrical circuit, aerodynamic performance, weatherproofing, manufacture, installation, loading or safety claim.
